fixes.change: Say the next rung in rupees. Compute var miss = ALL.filter(function (k) { return !bag[k]; }), adds = miss.map(function (k) { return effect(k, bag).adds; }), lo = adds.length ? Math.min.apply(null, adds) : 0; then write the line as pct(s.r[1]) + ' off applied' + (nx && lo > 0 ? ' · ' + pct(nx[1]) + ' off all ' + word(nx[0]) + (adds.length > 1 ? ' from ' : ' for ') + R(lo) + ' more' : nx ? ' · a ' + ORD[nx[0]] + ' piece makes it ' + pct(nx[1]) : ', the top rung'). roadmap: Owner, Buy now and the COD fee (notes 1). Buy now is the only route that reaches Fastrr with no rupee figure, and Fastrr books the 5% as shipping after a page that says 'Free insured delivery'. Read nf_bag_view and nf_bag_exit for two weeks, then decide between 'COD +5% fee' on the fact line (fits at 360) and keeping 'COD available'.
Owner: confirm the prepaid 5% (55 of ~105 prepaid orders carried it). Then the bag foot reads 'Pay online ₹2,279 · COD ₹2,519 (₹120 fee)' at equal weight, and Buy now can carry the online price.
Ops before launch: one Fastrr COD order to 800001 and 781001 (COD by pincode), and the label the 5% carries at Fastrr; measure the bracelet closed (fit range). Owner: the ₹3,999 basis.
Reviews (C4): a review app with requests 7 days after delivery and photo reviews; rating and count beside the H1 only from 5 real reviews [S16].
Ad map (C17): every live ad's utm_content in a <piece>_<asset>_<angle> convention, with the ads owner's own promise per angle; until then fold-ad.png correctly equals fold.png.

TEST INFRA, as in R3: a persisted 50/50 split by naira_vid hash; the arm passed to Fastrr (utm_term=pdp_a/pdp_b) so Shopify orders carry it; the arm as a Clarity tag; the new bag shipped for arm B only; the ladder frozen for the whole test; the template on every jewellery PDP (Prism alone sells about 10 a month).

TEST 1, new template vs live, mobile only (~7,970 mobile VC a week). ATC/VC from ~15.8%: +12% relative needs ~6,050 per arm (~1.5 weeks). IC/VC from ~3.0%: +20% needs ~13,900 per arm (~3.5 weeks). Orders/VC (~0.87%) needs ~50,000 per arm for +20%, so report it as probability-to-beat. Decide on IC/VC and orders/VC, not IC/ATC, for three named confounds: (a) Buy now fires ATC and IC together, so a shift toward Buy now raises IC/ATC mechanically, so split IC by nf_checkout.source; (b) the live bar's wishlist heart is gone in arm B, so some savers will use Add to bag as a save, which inflates ATC; (c) the live bag's 'Easy 7-day exchange & returns' (false) is absent in arm B. Expectations: ATC/VC +10–20%, IC/ATC −5% to +5%, purchase/IC +5–15%, items per order 1.51 → ~1.6, COD share −3 to −6 points. Guardrails: purchase/IC on Android, cancellations, RTO matured at 3 weeks.

TEST 2, post-add, inside the new template on the new bag: card + 'Bag & checkout' against an auto-opened bag that carries the 'Wear it with' row (one tap shorter, as live). Primary: orders per ATC session, read directionally; diagnostics nf_bag_view, nf_card_add against nf_drawer_add, and the nf_card_shown mode mix (after fixes 1–2, 'full' or 'compact' with the size line should cover most adds above the set).

TEST 3 and TEST 4, as in R3: the price-row slot ('Surgical steel, PVD rhodium' vs 'Waterproof · tarnish free'), and Buy now as the ink primary against Add to bag (68–74% of orders are one piece; guardrails COD share and RTO).

TEST 5, new, once nf_contact has two weeks of data: the reassurance list with the faulty-piece line first and Questions last, and @naira.flore as plain text, not a link, when the user agent contains 'Instagram' (the link opens the app, out of the webview). Keep the WhatsApp link. Primary: ATC/VC; diagnostic: nf_contact by channel against later ATC.
RUM inside the Instagram webview: field LCP, the nf_tap_guarded rate by control (if above ~2% of ATC, real double taps are common and the guards are earning their keep), and nf_bag_exit by device.
